ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Cathedral Pass
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Ash'karr campaign content: the Rust Cathedral's mechanoid pass (CATHEDRAL_MECHANOID_PASS_VERBS_1, arc spec §3 "Mechanoid pass", scope ruled 2026-09-13 to the narrowest reading).
A clan pawn carrying the RUT_CathedralPass flag is read as non-hostile by the mechanoid faction (faction 13, the Forgotten Arsenal) — but only on a Rust Cathedral map (RM_RustCathedral). Other mechanoid factions are not covered, and off Cathedral ground the pass does nothing. One scoped Harmony postfix on GenHostility.HostileTo(Thing, Thing) carries the whole mechanism.
This build ships the GRANT flag and the hostility exception only. The GM-layer verbs that decide WHEN the Cathedral grants or revokes the pass (stage VOUCHED+, priced against Imperial Heat, revoked on demotion) belong to the Regard blackboard and are not built here; until then the pass is granted and revoked through the dev-mode debug actions or the public CathedralPass.Grant/Revoke API.
The Cathedral's favours (CATHEDRAL_MISSION_BOON_OFFERS_1, arc spec §3 bullet 3) also live here: six requests to cull a pack of animals gone wrong (RUT_CathedralAssailantMission_*, vanilla quests with no asker, reaching the clan through the droid enclaves or the Utinni) and two gravtech gifts left by the ship unannounced (RUT_CathedralGravtechBoon_*). None is ever rolled by the storyteller: the GM blackboard (gm_blackboard_shadow.py) offers them — requests once the Cathedral tolerates the clan, gifts once it vouches for it and only while Imperial Heat is low — and fires them through the bridge. No text names the Cathedral.
Mod Settings: the pass kill switch, and one toggle each for the requests and the gifts.
